lighting_shading.note: Top-down light rays create a bright, airy underwater atmosphere.

value_contrast.note: Bright subjects stand out clearly against the deep blue water.

color_palette.note: Warm orange and yellow pop against the cool blue background.

composition_hierarchy.note: Diagonal flow leads the eye from the fish to the diver.

shape_proportions.note: Soft, rounded forms and exaggerated features create a friendly look.

viewpoint_depth.note: Clear depth layers from foreground coral to background water.

edges_linework.note: Clean edges defined by color contrast rather than dark outlines.

surface_finish.note: Smooth, soft 3D rendering with a clean, toy-like finish.

pose_rhythm.note: Dynamic swimming pose and reaching hand create a sense of motion.

idea.recognition_cue: Scuba diver and spiky yellow pufferfish
